_comment: Sample Coworker-style catalog. parentId null is Coworker's own list: its skills (playbooks that control orchestration) compete there with the agents it can delegate to.

catalog.name: pipeline-review-my
catalog.description: Reviews the open opportunities a rep owns: stage aging, close dates, next steps. Use when a rep asks about my own pipeline, my deals or my quota coverage. Not for a manager's view of reps: use pipeline-review-team.

should: how is my own pipeline looking
review my deals and close dates
what is my quota coverage this quarter
shouldNot: brief me on the Acme account

catalog.name: pipeline-review-team
catalog.description: Rolls up pipeline coverage and slipped deals across every rep reporting to a manager. Use when a manager asks about my team's pipeline, rep coverage or which reps are behind. Not for a single rep's deals: use pipeline-review-my.

should: how is my team's pipeline
which reps are behind on coverage
show slipped deals across reps
shouldNot: review my deals and close dates
update the stage on this opportunity

catalog.name: account-brief-my
catalog.description: Prepares a meeting brief on one account: contacts, open cases, recent activity and renewal date. Use when someone asks to be briefed on an account, or what to know before a customer meeting or call. Not for pipeline numbers: use pipeline-review-my.

should: brief me on the Acme account
prep me for my meeting with Globex
what should I know before the Initech call
shouldNot: how is my own pipeline looking

catalog.name: sales-agent
catalog.description: Writes changes to opportunities and accounts after confirmation: stage, amount, close date, next step. Use when the user asks to update, close or log something on a record. Not for reviews or briefs: use pipeline-review-my or account-brief-my.

should: update the stage on this opportunity
close this opportunity as won
log a call on the Acme record
shouldNot: review my deals and close dates
brief me on the Acme account

catalog.name: opportunity-updates
catalog.description: Changes fields on an opportunity record once the user confirms: stage, amount, close date, next step. Use when the user asks to update, move or close an opportunity. Not for activity logging: use activity-logging.

should: update the stage on this opportunity
move the close date to next month
close this opportunity as won
shouldNot: log a call on the Acme record
note that I emailed the buyer

catalog.name: activity-logging
catalog.description: Records calls, emails and meetings as activities against an account or contact. Use when the user asks to log a call, record an email or note a meeting. Not for changing opportunity fields: use opportunity-updates.

should: log a call on the Acme record
note that I emailed the buyer
record today's meeting with Globex
shouldNot: update the stage on this opportunity

catalog.name: stage-change-playbook
catalog.description: Procedure for moving an opportunity between stages: exit criteria per stage, required fields, and the confirmation format. Use when a deal is being moved or advanced to a new stage, such as proposal or negotiation. Not for close-won paperwork: use close-won-checklist.

should: move this deal to negotiation
what is needed to advance the stage
change stage to proposal
shouldNot: log a call on the Acme record

catalog.name: close-won-checklist
catalog.description: Checklist for closing an opportunity as won: signed contract, booking amount, handoff to onboarding. Use when a deal is being closed won or booked. Not for ordinary stage moves: use stage-change-playbook.

should: close this opportunity as won
book the Acme deal
we signed, mark it won
